WITH sales AS (
  SELECT product_code, region, amount, sold_on FROM sales_2026_q1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_code, region, amount, sold_on FROM sales_2026_q2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_code, region, amount, sold_on FROM sales_2026_q3
),
quarter_totals AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN sold_on >= '2026-01-01' AND sold_on < '2026-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN sold_on >= '2026-04-01' AND sold_on < '2026-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
    WHEN sold_on >= '2026-07-01' AND sold_on < '2026-10-01' THEN 'Q3'
  END AS q, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY q
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY region
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT product_code, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT product_code, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_code) AS rn
  FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 'overall' AS category, 'record_count' AS item, COUNT(*) AS value, NULL AS share_pct
FROM sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'overall', 'sales_amount', ROUND(SUM(amount), 2), NULL FROM sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'overall', 'distinct_products', COUNT(DISTINCT product_code), NULL FROM sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'quarter', q, ROUND(revenue, 2), NULL FROM quarter_totals
UNION ALL
SELECT 'quarter_growth', 'Q3_vs_Q2_pct',
       ROUND(100.0 * (q3.revenue - q2.revenue) / NULLIF(q2.revenue, 0), 2), NULL
FROM quarter_totals q2 JOIN quarter_totals q3 ON q2.q = 'Q2' AND q3.q = 'Q3'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'top_region', region, ROUND(revenue, 2),
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales), 2)
FROM region_totals
WHERE revenue = (SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM region_totals)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'top_product', product_code, ROUND(revenue, 2), NULL
FROM ranked_products WHERE rn <= 3
